event.title: One Wild Night: 2nd Annual Halloween Party
event.description: One Wild Night, 2nd Annual Halloween Party flyer, Pearl Street Brewing Co., Friday October 30 from 7 PM to 1 AM, 21 plus 🎪 2nd Annual · Pearl Street Brewing Co. Step Right Up. It Is Going To Be One Wild Night HALLOWEEN PARTY Three live bands, a DJ, and the whole brewery under the big top. Friday, October 30, 2026 · 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM 📍 Pearl Street Brewing Co. · 76 Pearl Street, Buffalo, NY 🎟️ Get Tickets · $25 📅 Date Fri, Oct. 30 ⏰ Party Starts 7:00 PM 🎸 Live Music 3 Bands + DJ 🍸 Last Call 1:00 AM 🎸 The Lineup ROYGBIV LIVE BAND The Tradesmen LIVE BAND Pocketship LIVE BAND DJ Kimonofox BETWEEN SETS 🎃 Under the Big Top Big-money costume contests $500 IN PRIZES Circus-themed photo booth STRIKE A POSE Door prizes all night GIVEAWAYS Halloween-inspired cocktails and drinks FULL BAR Spooky circus snacks and treats SNACKS General admission TICKETS $25 21+ with valid ID AGE POLICY 🎪 About the Night Step right up. It is going to be One Wild Night. This Halloween, Pearl Street Brewing Co. is once again transforming into a massively spooky night of live music, costumes, cocktails, prizes and surprises under the big top. It is the 2nd Annual Halloween Party, and it lands on the Friday before Halloween. Doors and music run from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM on Friday, October 30. Tickets are $25, and this is a 21+ night, so bring valid ID. Read More 🎸 Three Bands and a DJ We are bringing in three live bands to keep the party going all night: ROYGBIV, The Tradesmen and Pocketship, plus DJ Kimonofox keeping the music moving between sets. 🎃 More Than a Concert Come dressed to impress. There are big-money costume contests with $500 in prizes, a circus-themed photo booth, door prizes, spooky circus snacks and treats, Halloween-inspired cocktails and drinks, and plenty of surprises throughout the night. Grab a drink. Strike a pose. Catch three bands and a DJ. Show off your costume. Pearl Street Brewing Co. is at 76 Pearl Street in downtown Buffalo, inside Pearl Street Grill & Brewery, so the kitchen and the bars are right there all night. Get ready for One Wild Night at Pearl Street. Do not be the clown who misses the party. 🥂 21+ with Valid ID · Friday, October 30 · 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM General admission tickets $25 · Pearl Street Brewing Co., 76 Pearl Street 🎟️ Get Tickets · $25 ℹ️ Good to Know Before You Go ▼ 🎟️ How do I get tickets? ▼ Tickets are $25 and are sold through TicketPeak, the Pearl Street Family of Companies box office. Use the Get Tickets button on this page, or go to the listing on TicketPeak. 🕐 What time does it start and end? ▼ Music and doors run from 7:00 PM to 1:00 AM on Friday, October 30. Three bands and a DJ play across the night, so come early if you want to catch all of it. 🥂 Is there an age limit? ▼ Yes. This is a 21 and over event and valid ID is required for entry. 🎃 Do I have to wear a costume? ▼ Costumes are strongly encouraged. Come dressed to impress, because there are big-money costume contests with $500 in prizes, plus a circus-themed photo booth to show the whole thing off. 🎸 Who is playing? ▼ Three live bands: ROYGBIV, The Tradesmen and Pocketship. DJ Kimonofox keeps the music moving between sets. 🏢 Where in the building is the party? ▼ The party is at Pearl Street Brewing Co., inside Pearl Street Grill & Brewery at 76 Pearl Street, Buffalo, NY 14202. Head inside and staff will point you the rest of the way. Get directions. 🍽️ Is there food and drink? ▼ Yes. There are Halloween-inspired cocktails and drinks and spooky circus snacks and treats through the night. Pearl Street Grill & Brewery is a full restaurant and brewery with house-made craft beer on tap and bars across four floors. Food and drinks are available for purchase and are not included with your ticket. 🚗 Where do I park? ▼ There are several lots and ramps within a short walk of 76 Pearl Street. See our parking page for the full rundown of nearby options. ↗ Other questions? Contact Pearl Street Grill & Brewery

event.description: Jamsgiving 2026 flyer, Pearl Street Grill & Brewery, Wednesday November 25 from 8 PM to 1 AM 🍂 House Hustlers Presents · 2nd Annual JAMSGIVING Thanksgiving Eve 2026 11 Acts. 3 Floors. 1 Amazing Night. Wednesday, November 25, 2026 · 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM 📍 Pearl Street Grill & Brewery · 76 Pearl Street, Buffalo, NY 14202 🎟️ Get Tickets · $25 Proceeds benefit WNY Drummers for Homeless People 📅 Date Wed, Nov. 25 ⏰ Music Starts 8:00 PM 🎸 Live Music 11 Acts, 3 Floors 🌙 Night Ends 1:00 AM 🎤 The Lineup · 11 Acts Grace Greenan LIVE Witty Tarbox LIVE Roy G Biv LIVE Tsavo Highway LIVE Johnny Hart & The Mess LIVE Max Childs LIVE G Premacy LIVE Johnny & The Man Kids LIVE Hartwell Hospice House Band LIVE Call Me Disaster LIVE Kase Klosed LIVE 🍂 The Night at a Glance 11 acts across 3 floors LIVE MUSIC The best of WNY and Buffalo music, across genres ALL GENRES Ticket profits benefit WNY Drummers for Homeless People GIVING BACK Online tickets $25, plus a $3 service fee at checkout BUY ONLINE Tickets at the door $35 DOOR PRICE A limited number of tickets available LIMITED 21+ with valid ID AGE POLICY 🦃 About the Night JAMSGIVING IS BACK! House Hustlers presents the 2nd Annual JAMSGIVING, taking over Pearl Street Grill & Brewery on Thanksgiving Eve. We’re bringing together 11 acts across 3 floors for one huge night of live music in the heart of downtown Buffalo, celebrating the best of WNY and Buffalo’s music scene, across genres, all in one place. Music runs 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM on Wednesday, November 25. Tickets are $25 online or $35 at the door, and ticket profits benefit WNY Drummers for Homeless People. Read More 🏠 Come Home for Thanksgiving Eve Thanksgiving Eve is already one of Buffalo’s biggest nights to get together. This year, come home, grab your friends, fill Pearl Street, discover some great local music, and help us do some good while we’re at it. 💛 Music That Gives Back Ticket profits are donated to benefit WNY Drummers for Homeless People, supporting people in need in our community during the holidays. 🤝 Thanks to Our Partners JAMSGIVING is made possible by House Hustlers at Metro Roberts Realty, Orchard Park Progressive Physical Therapy, B-Sharp Productions, WNY Drummers for Homeless People, Junior Jerry Jam, Stamm Law Firm, I Love Buffalo Podcast, Cinema & Sound, 97 Rock, Ripe Audio, and other community partners. 🥂 21+ with Valid ID · Wednesday, November 25 · 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM $25 online, plus a $3 service fee at checkout · $35 at the door · Limited number available 🎟️ Get Tickets · $25 ℹ️ Good to Know Before You Go ▼ 🎟️ How much are tickets, and where do I get them? ▼ Tickets are $25 online, plus a $3 service fee at checkout, sold through TicketPeak, the Pearl Street Family of Companies box office. Tickets at the door are $35. Only a limited number are available, so grab yours online with the Get Tickets button or at the listing on TicketPeak. 🕐 When is it? ▼ JAMSGIVING is on Wednesday, November 25, 2026, Thanksgiving Eve, from 8:00 PM to 1:00 AM. With 11 acts across 3 floors, come early to catch as much music as you can. 🥂 Is there an age limit? ▼ Yes. This is a 21 and over event and valid ID is required for entry. 🎸 Who is playing? ▼ 11 acts across 3 floors: Grace Greenan, Witty Tarbox, Roy G Biv, Tsavo Highway, Johnny Hart & The Mess, Max Childs, G Premacy, Johnny & The Man Kids, Hartwell Hospice House Band, Call Me Disaster and Kase Klosed. 💛 Where does the money go? ▼ Ticket profits are donated to benefit WNY Drummers for Homeless People, supporting people in need in our community during the holidays. 🏢 Where is it? ▼ Pearl Street Grill & Brewery, 76 Pearl Street, Buffalo, NY 14202, in the heart of downtown Buffalo. The music runs across 3 floors of the building. Get directions. 🤝 Who puts on JAMSGIVING? ▼ House Hustlers presents JAMSGIVING, together with Orchard Park Progressive Physical Therapy, B-Sharp Productions, WNY Drummers for Homeless People, Junior Jerry Jam, Stamm Law Firm, I Love Buffalo Podcast, Cinema & Sound, 97 Rock, Ripe Audio, and other community partners. 🚗 Where do I park? ▼ There are several lots and ramps within a short walk of 76 Pearl Street.
